summary: A grid of selectable image options, like choosing a theme.
description: A container that groups related moz-visual-picker-item children and allows a user to navigate between them to select one item. The appearance of each item is determined by the consumer's slotted content.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label for the group of elements.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description for the group of elements.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name used to associate items in the group. Propagates to moz-visual-picker-item children.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected value for the group. Changing the value updates the checked state of moz-visual-picker-item children and vice versa.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout orientation of the picker, "horizontal" (default) or "vertical". Propagates to moz-visual-picker-item children.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The picker's content, intended for moz-visual-picker-item children.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles up from a selected child item; the picker updates its value accordingly.

usage:
<moz-visual-picker value="1" name="theme">
  <moz-visual-picker-item value="1" label="Light"></moz-visual-picker-item>
  <moz-visual-picker-item value="2" label="Dark"></moz-visual-picker-item>
</moz-visual-picker>
